segments.name: Online gambling affiliate
segments.description: Earns revenue by referring online gamblers to operators and by selling data, analytics and advertising services.
segments.evidence: the CODM operates and manages the Group's entire operations as one segment, which is consistent with the Group's internal organization and reporting system.

revenueModel.text: Online gambling operators pay the company per referred player through CPA fees, revenue share, or both, and subscribers pay for data services.
revenueModel.evidence: CPA fees for each referred player are recognized when earned upon acceptance of the referral by the online gambling operator.
